en.html:
My agreement was not bursting with enthusiasm. First, my own position. Second, my brain was still half a step behind what was happening.

But I made myself catch up.

Rokuhara might be evil. That did not make terrorism against it good. Evil on this side did not issue a certificate of goodness to that side.

If we could prevent it, obviously we should. And if the voices were only a hallucination and all this effort went nowhere... chalega. That would be fine too.

If we could prevent it, obviously we should. And if the voices were only a hallucination and all this effort went nowhere... chalega. That would be fine too.

しても……それはそれで別に構うまい。

en.html:
We followed Chachamaru Ashikaga through the seats. Muramasa came too, looking as if the whole business had given her indigestion.

Ahead of us, the girl walked without tension or hesitation.

...Still a mystery. What exactly could she do?

Hear a conversation far away, then know precisely where it was happening—apparently. This could not be just slightly sharper ears.

Shooting Star Gang Member A"Yes. Ten deaths today, so a hundred lives are saved tomorrow."
Shooting Star Gang Member A"To defeat you and save Yamato, who would object to being sacrificed? Nobody! No... anyone who objects is the same as you. Kill them with you also, no problem!"

en.html:
So easily he fixed the value of other people's lives.

—Samajh gaya.
Now I understood what was underneath my anger, my hatred.

This fellow was very like somebody I knew.
The man who appeared when I looked in a mirror. Exactly the same work.

That was why I could not forgive him.

Kageaki"...Bas. Enough bakwaas. I don't want to hear it. Surrender."
Kageaki"I will hand you over to the courts. You will receive the punishment you deserve."
Shooting Star Gang Member A"Your laws? We follow heaven's command! Your laws cannot bind us!"
Shooting Star Gang Member A"By heaven's command we will keep fighting. Until Rokuhara is crushed!"
Kageaki"Heaven's command...? THIS is what heaven told you to do?!"
Shooting Star Gang Member A"Exactly! This is the battle heaven commands!"
Shooting Star Gang Member A"Our guide, the great Divine General, teaches us so!"
Kageaki"Divine General...?"
Chachamaru"Silver Star. Princess, he means."

景明「司法に預け、相応の刑を受けてもらう」

景明「神将……？」
茶々丸「銀星号おひめのこったよ」
